description.narrative:
(i) Market creation Competitiveness By supporting the first Pan-American integrated 3 P TCL provider, IFC expects the Project to contribute to market competitiveness by increasing the penetration of outsourced TCL services in the DR, Ecuador and Peru.
(ii) Economy-wide effects: These assets will support economic growth and job creation in the target markets, directly and through economic linkages to retail and agribusiness.
(iii) Environmental effects: The Project is expected to contribute to emissions savings through the adoption of climate mitigation practices (including but not limited to green building EDGE certifications and introduction of efficiency standards).

Emergent Cold LATAM Holdings, LLC (Emergent LatAm or Company) is a recently established platform for investments in the 3rd party temperature-controlled logistics (3P TCL) sector in LAC. The Company targets providing refrigerated storage, transportation and other value-added services via integrated, end-to-end solutions to clients across the processed foods, dairy, meat, seafood, fruits & vegetables, across several countries in Latin America & Caribbean. The Company is scaling up its Latin American coverage through a mix of acquisitions and greenfield/brownfield developments, in a region where the sector is underdeveloped and fragmented. The first round of greenfield facilities currently being built are located in (i) Callao, Peru, (ii) Duran, Ecuador, and (iii) Caucedo, Dominican Republic.
